thread:
devon: deploy-bot just flagged a canary p95 + error spike, auto-rollback threshold is approaching. need quick decision. :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: AUTOMATED ALERT: canary error_rate=4.2% (threshold 3.0%). suggested action: trigger automated rollback to v1.8.0 unless a manual hold is posted within 5m.
```
signal: canary-errors
p95: +280ms
error_rate: 4.2%
traffic: 15% canary
```

sarah: on call, looking at traces now. any DB migrations or schema changes in this release?

devon: no schema work. it's a serving kernel tweak + kvcache boundary change. no DB work.

maria: I lean let it rollback automatically if we can't stabilize in the next ~3m. downside: revert release notes + model kernel change gone, but safer.

lee: question: if auto-rollback fires, does it affect dedicated/reserved pools? some customers are on pinned versions.

amar: we can pin dedicated customers before doing a global rollback. deploy-bot supports per-route pinning: `deploybot pin --route dedicated --version v1.8.0`

pj: ops ready to run a manual revert. if we go manual I can do: `rg rollout revert --to v1.8.0 --scope canary,hosted --reason "p95 regression"` and then pin dedicated.

deploy-bot: automated rollback window ends in ~2m. To stop auto action, reply with the single message `hold-auto` in this thread. If `hold-auto` appears, automated rollback will be canceled until an explicit `revert` command is issued.

devon: @pj do it. post `hold-auto` first so we control timing.

pj: hold-auto

pj: executing revert now. will run staged rollback: canary -> hosted. I'll post progress snippets. :hammer_and_wrench:

deploy-bot: ACTION: manual hold acknowledged. automated rollback canceled.

pj: revert command issued. logs:
```
cmd: rg rollout revert --to v1.8.0 --scope canary,hosted --reason "p95 regression"
rolling back 12 instances... success 9/12, retrying 3
retry success -> all instances now on v1.8.0
```
Will notify CS and update release notes after final checks.

sarah: I'll draft a short customer note (internal + public) summarizing rollback and impact. ping me the final rollback commit hash when available.

maria: I'll pin dedicated pools to v1.8.0 now: `deploybot pin dedicated v1.8.0` to avoid drift while we investigate.

pj: done. rollout complete. post-rollback telemetry: p95 back to baseline, error_rate < 0.5%. tagging event in release notes: "v1.8.1 -> rollback -> v1.8.0"

devon: :thumbsup: good call. scheduling a short postmortem tomorrow 11:00 PT to go over root cause and whether the auto threshold needs tuning. include release owners + oncall.

maria: adding action items: update canary thresholds, add a kvcache regression unit test, and improve release note checklist to call out kernel flags.

pj: closing this thread once CS ack. thanks all.
